final: WITH groups AS (SELECT m.link_to_major, a.college, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS a ON m.link_to_major = a.major_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m.link_to_major, a.college), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups), shares AS (SELECT g.link_to_major, g.college, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.total_count AS share FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), college_averages AS (SELECT college, AVG(share) AS college_average FROM shares GROUP BY college) SELECT s.link_to_major, s.college, s.group_count, s.share, s.share - c.college_average AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN college_averages AS c ON s.college = c.college_average COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.share > c.college_average ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
